description: Wallet Tasks 5-6: Windows SecureKeyStore adapter (Ed25519 key generation, signing, storage via trust-protocol conformance harness) and secure device pairing with agent registration (one-time pairing, proof-of-possession, Agent URI)
steps: Task 5 - SecureKeyStore port in packages/wallet-domain/src/secure-key-store.ts: Define the SecureKeyStore interface (port) with methods: generateKey(scope), getPublicDescriptor(keyId), sign(keyId, canonicalBytes), revokeKey(keyId), lockStore(), unlockStore(credential), isLocked(). Key material must never be exported. Use Ed25519 via @noble/ed25519. This consumes the foundation conformance harness pattern from @counter/trust-protocol.

Task 5 - In-memory SecureKeyStore implementation in packages/wallet-domain/src/in-memory-key-store.ts: Implement InMemorySecureKeyStore for testing that stores keys in a Map, enforces lock/unlock semantics, refuses sign() when locked, and tracks key status (active, revoked). Private keys never exposed through any public API.

Task 5 - Windows adapter stub in packages/wallet-domain/src/windows-key-store.ts: Create a WindowsSecureKeyStore class that implements SecureKeyStore interface. For the pilot, this uses the InMemorySecureKeyStore internally but documents the Windows Credential Manager/DPAPI integration point. Mark with TODO for production OS-specific implementation.

Task 5 - SecureKeyStore conformance test harness in packages/wallet-domain/src/secure-key-store.test.ts: Tests covering: key generation produces valid Ed25519 public key descriptor, sign() produces verifiable signatures, sign() rejects when locked, revoked key refuses sign(), key material never appears in errors/logs/exports, concurrent sign operations are safe, corrupt/missing storage handled gracefully, process restart preserves key status.

Task 6 - Device pairing in packages/wallet-application/src/device-pairing.ts: Implement PairingRequest (short-lived, one-time, contains proof-of-possession challenge, walletId, expiresAt, status: pending/consumed/expired/cancelled). Implement PairingService with: createPairingRequest(walletId, principalId), consumePairing(requestId, proofOfPossession, deviceInfo), cancelPairing(requestId). Atomic consume prevents replay.

Task 6 - Agent registration in packages/wallet-application/src/agent-registration.ts: Implement AgentRegistration (agentId as stable Agent URI, walletId, publicKeyDescriptor, registeredAt, status, deviceId, registrationCertificate). Implement AgentRegistrationService with: register(walletId, pairingProof, publicKey, deviceInfo), rotate(agentId, newPublicKey, proofOfOldKey), suspend(agentId), revoke(agentId). Registration requires completed pairing + step-up approval.
Task 6 - Agent URI generation: Create stable, non-secret Agent URIs using CounterId with 'agent' kind. Distinct from payment references.
Task 6 - Registration certificate: Generate a CTP envelope (counter.agent-registration.v1) binding agent, wallet, public key, device, and principal approval.

Task 6 - Negative tests for Task 6: Test expired pairing rejected, replay of consumed pairing rejected, wrong-wallet pairing rejected, duplicate registration rejected, pairing grants no mandate/transaction authority, interception attempt (wrong proof-of-possession) rejected.
Ensure private key never appears in any toString(), toJSON(), log, error message, or diagnostic output. Run all verification commands.
acceptance_criteria: SecureKeyStore port defines complete interface for key lifecycle without key export
InMemorySecureKeyStore passes conformance harness (generate, sign, lock/unlock, revoke)
Ed25519 signatures produced by SecureKeyStore verify correctly with trust-protocol verify
Pairing is one-time atomic consume with proof-of-possession
Agent registration produces stable Agent URI and CTP registration certificate
Revoked keys refuse sign(), expired pairings refuse consume
Private key material never appears in any public surface (APIs, errors, logs, diagnostics)
All builds, tests, lint, and depcruise pass

findings: The fs_write tool did not persist files to the filesystem in this session; had to use bash heredocs (cat > file << EOF) instead. exactOptionalPropertyTypes is enforced globally - optional fields in interfaces must use '?: T | undefined' syntax to avoid assignment errors when using spread. The dep cruiser allows wallet-domain to import trust-protocol - no boundary violation. Added @noble/ed25519 2.2.3 to wallet-domain and wallet-application - both resolved from existing lockfile without network. wallet-domain tests: 103 total (59 existing + 44 new). wallet-application tests: 70 total (52 existing + 18 new).
